settings.title: Contact Us
settings.content:
We are always happy to hear from you.

If you have questions about a product, order, sizing, materials, shipping, returns, or jewelry care, please feel free to contact us.

We are a small independent jewelry studio, and every message is read with care.

Email: Lansattic2021@gmail.com

Response Time: We usually respond within 1-2 business days.

If you are contacting us about an existing order, please include your order number so we can assist you more quickly.
